# Digital Appendix {#sec-appendix-b}

All files of this thesis are stored in the Git repository [github.com/snehashree499/thesis_sneha](https://github.com/snehashree499/thesis_sneha) and on the USB stick that is handed in with the printed thesis. The source code of the final build is Git commit `4243dc6` (@tbl-versions).

The following overview shows the folders that belong to the thesis. The paths are shortened, and folders that only contain temporary build files are not listed.

<!-- [NEW] tree with plain ASCII signs and shorter lines, so nothing is cut in the PDF -->
```t
thesis_sneha/
|-- GateMate-FPGA-Projects/
|   |-- FlexLink_Node_v1/          # final design of the Flexlink node
|   |   |-- flexlink_node.v        # Verilog design
|   |   |-- flexlink_node.ccf      # constraint file
|   |   |-- tb_flexlink_node.v     # testbench (Icarus Verilog)
|   |   |-- build.bat              # synthesis, place and route, programming
|   |   |-- sim.bat                # simulation (Icarus Verilog)
|   |   |-- flexlink_pc_test.py    # PC test program
|   |   |-- flexlink_node.bit      # bitstream of the final build
|   |   `-- utilisation.json       # resource and timing report
|   `-- Picoscope_outputs/
|       |-- Final_outputs/         # captures (.psdata) and decoder exports (.csv)
|       `-- PWM_16Bit_*.png        # PWM captures
|-- matlab_model/
|   |-- simulink_model/
|   |   `-- GateMate_SingleWire_TxRx_RGBW.slx   # Simulink model
|   `-- behavioural_model/
|       |-- run_singlewire_txrx_rgbw.m          # script that runs the model
|       `-- export_ch4_figures.m                # exports the figures of Ch. 4
`-- thesis/                        # Quarto source of this document
    |-- content/                   # chapters and figures
    |-- appendix/                  # appendices
    `-- _bibliography/             # references
```

How to repeat the main steps:

1. **Simulation of the Verilog design.** Run `sim.bat` in `FlexLink_Node_v1`. It compiles the design and the testbench with Icarus Verilog and runs the simulation.
2. **Build and programming.** Run `build.bat` in `FlexLink_Node_v1`. It runs Yosys, nextpnr, gmpack and openFPGALoader with the commands shown in @sec-hw-flow and loads the bitstream into both boards.
3. **Hardware test.** Connect the boards as in @tbl-wiring and run `python flexlink_pc_test.py`.
4. **Simulink model.** Open MATLAB R2025b in `matlab_model/behavioural_model` and run `run_singlewire_txrx_rgbw.m`.
5. **Thesis document.** Run `quarto render` in the folder `thesis`.
